items: The circuit breaker of the bay on which the protection device mentioned is installed is open.
Fence off the work area and place warning signs.
Follow the occupational safety and health instructions for the safety of personnel and equipment.

sections_target.text: Secondary injection test set, model a3/TRE-F (ISA)

items: Secondary injection test set, model a3/TRE-F (ISA)

rows: Check that the Uaux lamp, indicating arrival of the supply voltage to the protection device, is lit.
Connect the current injection leads between the injection test set and the protection device mentioned as follows: N-25, T-8, S-5, R-2.

sections_target.text: Testing the overcurrent protection element of the device

rows: Set the initial value of the current to be raised on the test switch of the injection test set, x5A.
Raise the current of phase 'R' gradually until the I>/In lamp on the protection device lights up, and record the pick-up value.
Reduce the current gradually for the same phase (R) until the I>/In lamp goes out, and record the reset value.

sections_target.text: Measuring the time delay of the overcurrent protection element

rows: Connect the two timer leads of the injection test set to points 65 and 66 on the protection device.
Raise the current on phase 'R' to the preset setting value (SETTING) on the relay.
Switch the injection test set 'Off' at this current.
Switch the injection test set 'On' at the same previous setting.
Note the start of the timer count; when it stops, note that the injection test set switches off automatically, with the [Trip, I>/In, t>] lamps lit.
Record the time delay values and the injection current values at which they were measured.

sections_target.text: Testing the short-circuit overcurrent protection element of the device

rows: Set the initial value of the current to be raised on the test switch of the injection test set, x5A.
Raise the current of phase 'R' to the preset setting value and record the value at which the [Trip, I>>/In, t>>] lamps light up.

sections_target.text: Testing the earth leakage protection element of the device

rows: Connect the current injection leads between the injection test set and the protection device mentioned as follows: R-25, N-26.
Set the initial value of the current to be raised on the test switch of the injection test set, x5A.
Raise the current of phase 'R' gradually until the Io>In lamp lights up, and record the PICK-UP values.
Reduce the current gradually until the Io>In lamp goes out, and record the RESET value.

sections_target.text: Measuring the time delay of the earth leakage protection element

rows: Connect the two timer leads to points 65, 66 on the protection device.
Raise the current, with the same connections mentioned in item 7, to the device setting value.
Switch the injection test set 'Off' at this current.
Note the start of the timer count; when it stops, note that the injection test set switches off automatically, with the [Trip, Io>In, t>] lamps lit.
Record the time and current values and reset the protection device.
This completes the testing of the three elements (overcurrent protection, short-circuit current protection and earth leakage protection) in the protection device.
Review the results, record them, sign them and note the test date on the attached test results sheet.

Safety Precautions

Procedures to be Carried Out
Check that the Uaux lamp, indicating arrival of the supply voltage to the protection device, is lit. | 1.
Connect the current injection leads between the injection test set and the protection device mentioned as follows: N-25, T-8, S-5, R-2. | 2.
Testing the overcurrent protection element of the device
Set the initial value of the current to be raised on the test switch of the injection test set, x5A. | 1.
Raise the current of phase 'R' gradually until the I>/In lamp on the protection device lights up, and record the pick-up value. | 2.
Reduce the current gradually for the same phase (R) until the I>/In lamp goes out, and record the reset value. | 3.
Measuring the time delay of the overcurrent protection element
Connect the two timer leads of the injection test set to points 65 and 66 on the protection device. | 1.
Raise the current on phase 'R' to the preset setting value (SETTING) on the relay. | 2.
Switch the injection test set 'Off' at this current. | 3.
Reset the timer. | 4.
Switch the injection test set 'On' at the same previous setting. | 5.
Note the start of the timer count; when it stops, note that the injection test set switches off automatically, with the [Trip, I>/In, t>] lamps lit. | 6.
Record the time delay values and the injection current values at which they were measured. | 7.
Testing the short-circuit overcurrent protection element of the device
Set the initial value of the current to be raised on the test switch of the injection test set, x5A. | 1.
Raise the current of phase 'R' to the preset setting value and record the value at which the [Trip, I>>/In, t>>] lamps light up. | 2.
Testing the earth leakage protection element of the device
Connect the current injection leads between the injection test set and the protection device mentioned as follows: R-25, N-26. | 1.
Set the initial value of the current to be raised on the test switch of the injection test set, x5A. | 2.
Raise the current of phase 'R' gradually until the Io>In lamp lights up, and record the PICK-UP values. | 3.
Reduce the current gradually until the Io>In lamp goes out, and record the RESET value. | 4.
Measuring the time delay of the earth leakage protection element
Connect the two timer leads to points 65, 66 on the protection device. | 1.
Raise the current, with the same connections mentioned in item 7, to the device setting value. | 2.
Switch the injection test set 'Off' at this current. | 3.
Reset the timer. | 4.
Switch the injection test set 'On'. | 5.
Note the start of the timer count; when it stops, note that the injection test set switches off automatically, with the [Trip, Io>In, t>] lamps lit. | 6.
Record the time and current values and reset the protection device. | 7.
This completes the testing of the three elements (overcurrent protection, short-circuit current protection and earth leakage protection) in the protection device. | 8.
Review the results, record them, sign them and note the test date on the attached test results sheet. | 9.
